Rep. Ilhan Omar's Phone Seized, Family Subpoenaed in Federal Probe

Federal investigators seized the phone of U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar and issued subpoenas to her family members as part of an immigration status probe. The investigation is reportedly criminal in nature. Details regarding the specific allegations or the scope of the investigation were not immediately disclosed.
